The '''1933–34 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by four points over nearest rival [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]]. [[Third Lanark A.C.|Third Lanark]] and [[Cowdenbeath F.C.|Cowdenbeath]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1934–35 Scottish Division Two]].
